'''The&nbsp;''IMA Journal of Applied Mathematics''''' is a publication of [[Oxford University Press]] on behalf of the [[Institute of Mathematics and its Applications]]. Created in 1965, the Journal covers topics related to the application of mathematics.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://academic.oup.com/imamat/pages/About|last=Oxford University Press|title=IMA Journal of Applied Mathematics: About the Journal|language=en|date=2020|access-date=17 July 2020}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://ncbiinsights.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/2018/06/15/pubmed-journals-shut-down|title=PubMed Journals: IMA Journal of Applied Mathematics|website=PubMed Journals|language=en|access-date=2017-10-31}}</ref>
